description: This Java source file defines a custom watch face service for Android Wear OS that displays upcoming calendar meetings. It loads calendar data asynchronously, handles permission requests, and updates the display with the number of meetings.

classes.name: CalendarWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService responsible for creating the watch face engine.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, manages drawing, permissions, data loading, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: LoadMeetingsTask
classes.description: AsyncTask subclass that loads calendar meetings asynchronously and updates the UI.

methods.name: onCreateEngine
methods.description: Creates and returns a new Engine instance for the watch face.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the engine, sets up style, resources, and permissions.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up handler messages and resources when the engine is destroyed.

methods.name: onTapCommand
methods.description: Handles tap gestures, potentially prompting for permissions.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the current state onto the Canvas, displaying meeting info.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Starts or stops updates and receiver registration based on visibility.

methods.name: onMeetingsLoaded
methods.description: Updates the number of meetings and redraws the watch face.
